description: atom.geo-ide.e2.rie.gouv.fr: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.e2.rie.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by atom.geo-ide.e2.rie.gouv.fr. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Arret de bus en Aveyron; Lignes de bus du réseau Mobi midi pyrénée - 2018; Classement sonore des voies de tramway du Rhône 2015. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
